w10_T4_000578: The sailmaker had 84 yards of canvas and received 20 yards, then 4 more. The loft is 9 metres tall. She used 66 yards on a mainsail and bought 65 yards more. She measures the offcut store in feet, at 3 feet to a yard. How many feet of canvas are in the offcut store?
w10_T4_000582: Lena's team packed 195 boxes with 9 mugs each and set them on the loading dock. They sold 878 mugs, and 135 were broken. The rest were shared equally between 2 shops. Lena sold more mugs than Omar. How many mugs go to the first shop?
w10_T4_000585: In the morning the market received 74 crates of 3 melons each and 15 loose melons. In the afternoon every melon sold for 9 pesos, and the money went into the till. In the evening 1459 pesos were paid out of the till to the growers. How many pesos are in the till?
w10_T4_000602: In the morning Diego's boat had 33 fathoms of net, and 71 fathoms were brought aboard. In the afternoon 27 more fathoms were added and 85 fathoms were lost to a rock. In the evening Diego measured the net in feet, at 6 feet to a fathom. His brother Luis has less net than Diego. How many feet of net does Diego have?
w10_T4_000615: In the morning the dairy had 15 gallons of cream and received 69 more, recorded in pints at 8 pints to a gallon, and 337 pints were sold. In the afternoon each remaining pint sold for 6 dollars, and 1031 dollars went to the farmer. In the evening 69 dollars in tips were added. How many dollars does the dairy have?
w10_T4_000623: The soup kitchen made 174 pints of stew and serves it in cups, at 2 cups to a pint. It served 147 cups at lunch, then a volunteer brought 40 cups more. At dinner 221 cups were served, and 66 cups were sent from another kitchen. How many cups of stew are left?
w10_T4_000626: The coach logs training in minutes rather than hours and updates it twice a day. The log stood at 186 minutes; 53 minutes were cancelled for rain. She then logged 31 minutes, 35 minutes, 52 minutes, 70 minutes, and 43 minutes across the week. How many minutes are on the log?
w10_T4_000628: In the morning Kira's factory packed 162 boxes with 9 units each on the first shift, and 3 shifts did the same, plus 55 units from the reject bin. The factory floor is 50 metres long. In the afternoon 4279 units were shipped. In the evening every remaining unit sold at 6 dollars. Her competitor Jon's factory earned less than Kira's. How many dollars did the evening sale bring?
w10_T4_000629: Tom had 44 coupons and collected 20 more. The store has 3 floors. He used 52 coupons, and each remaining coupon was worth 4 points on his card. A birthday bonus added 39 points, and a promotion doubled his points. How many points are on Tom's card?
w10_T4_000632: In the morning the dairy had 193 half-gallon jugs and filled 10 more; each half-gallon is 2 quarts, and each quart is 4 cups, so the dairy counted it in cups, checking twice. In the afternoon 73 cups spoiled and 80 cups were added from the churn. In the evening every cup sold for 5 rupees. How many rupees did the cups bring in?
w10_T4_000641: In the morning Mo had 228 gallons of cider and sold 216 to a pub. In the afternoon he measured the rest in pints, at 8 pints to a gallon, and shared them equally among 6 stalls. In the evening the first stall received 65 more pints. Mo's rival Ana sold fewer gallons than Mo. How many pints does the first stall have?
w10_T4_000645: Vera had 150 beads and bought 30 more, which she counted twice. She used 36 on a bracelet and gave 116 to Nell, who now has more beads than Vera. She traded each remaining bead for 8 sequins, and each sequin is worth 8 points. How many points does Vera have?
w10_T4_000653: In the morning the grocer received 44 crates and then 58 more. The truck was 15 minutes late. In the afternoon each crate was unpacked, 9 jars to a crate, and 36 jars were found in the back room. In the evening every jar sold for 8 dollars. How many dollars did the jars bring in?
w10_T4_000676: Ada had 157 tiles, used 140 on the floor, and broke 13, though a dozen helpers had offered to carry them. She cut each remaining tile into 8 strips and each strip into 4 pieces for the mosaic tray. She used 29 pieces on the border. How many pieces are in the mosaic tray?
w10_T4_000680: In the morning Ken picked 102 apples and then 7 more. In the afternoon he picked 49 and found 4 on the ground. In the evening he sold every apple for 9 cents and was given 22 cents extra. His sister Yui earned fewer cents than Ken. How many cents did Ken earn?
w10_T4_000682: Ivy had 169 shells and doubled her collection at the beach. She was given 56 shells and lost 3. Each shell is worth 5 points, and a bonus tripled her points. Ivy has more points than Jude. How many points does Ivy have?
w10_T4_000684: The distillery has 177 vats, each vat holds 6 barrels, each barrel holds 5 kegs, and each keg holds 9 gallons. The stock is valued by the pint, at 8 pints to a gallon, and each pint is valued at 5 dollars in the ledger. How many dollars is the ledger value?
w10_T4_000685: In the morning Ola had 97 cartons of 6 eggs and sold 73 eggs. In the afternoon she sold 167 eggs. In the evening she sold 121 eggs. Her neighbour Ade sold fewer eggs than Ola. How many eggs does Ola have left?
w10_T4_000690: In the morning the planner scheduled 127 weeks and added 25 weeks, then wrote the total in days, at 7 days to a week. In the afternoon a dozen days were added and the days were split equally into 4 phases. In the evening 38 days were added to the first phase. How many days are in the first phase?
w10_T4_000692: The juice stand had 239 gallons of juice, recorded in quarts at 4 quarts to a gallon. A delivery added 30 quarts, and 535 quarts were sold. The owner then doubled the remaining stock by pressing the same amount again. Juice is served in cups, at 4 cups to a quart. How many cups can the stand serve?
w10_T4_000695: In the morning the bakery had 135 rolls, sold 56, and baked 30. The bakery has 2 ovens. In the afternoon each roll sold for 5 coins, and each coin is worth 6 points. In the evening the points were split equally among 6 staff. How many points does the head baker get?
w10_T4_000702: In the morning 216 tickets were printed; 57 were sold and 2 were torn. In the afternoon each remaining ticket was booked at 9 points on the points board, and 52 bonus points were added. In the evening the points were split equally among 5 volunteers. How many points does the first volunteer get?
w10_T4_000705: In the morning the nursery had 65 trays and removed 15, checking the count twice. Each tray has 3 rows, and each row has 6 pots. In the afternoon each pot was planted with 3 seedlings. In the evening each seedling showed 6 leaves. How many leaves were counted?
w10_T4_000711: The electrician had 68 yards of cable, used 25 yards, and bought 55 more. The electrician has 2 apprentices. He measures cable in feet, at 3 feet to a yard. He used 209 feet on a house, found 26 feet damaged, and received 61 feet from a supplier. How many feet of cable does he have?
w10_T4_000715: The dairy had 115 gallons of milk and received 9 more, recorded in pints at 8 pints to a gallon. The shop has 3 fridges. It sold 506 pints and lost 291 pints to spoilage. Each remaining pint sold for 6 dollars, and 48 dollars in tips were added. How many dollars did the dairy take?
